description: For every map \(f:X\to Y\) and finite set \(U\subseteq X\), the finite image satisfies \(f[U]=\varnothing\) if and only if \(U=\varnothing\).
signature:
Finset.image_eq_empty.{u_1, u_2} {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [DecidableEq β] {f : α → β} {s : Finset α} :
  Finset.image f s = ∅ ↔ s = ∅
